blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
As mobile robots become increasingly integrated into everyday environments, privacy risks arising from onboard cameras have become a growing concern.
Ultra-low-resolution (ULR) RGB can mitigate visual privacy exposure at the source, but ULR appearance alone substantially limits semantic and spatial understanding.
We therefore introduce a privacy-preserving asymmetric sensing setting that combines high-resolution (HR) depth with ULR RGB, preserving dense geometry while restricting fine-grained visual information.
To address the severe information imbalance between HR depth and ULR RGB, we propose a joint 2D framework using HR geometry to guide semantic-oriented RGB reconstruction and RGB-D segmentation.
Despite reliable frame-level predictions, consistent scene-level understanding remains challenging under the asymmetric HR depth–ULR RGB setting.
We therefore develop an end-to-end 2D-to-3D pipeline that consolidates 2D semantic features for 3D segmentation.
Experiments on ScanNet show that our method achieves the best 2D and 3D segmentation performance among privacy-preserving approaches and delivers the strongest zero-shot transfer to SUN RGB-D and SceneNN.
Privacy recoverability analysis shows that our proposed HR depth–ULR RGB input reduces the recoverability of sensitive data, and real-robot experiments demonstrate the utility of the resulting 3D semantics for object-goal navigation.
blocks.zh:
随着移动机器人日益融入日常环境,机载相机带来的隐私风险日益成为人们的关注.
超低分辨率(ULR)RGB可以减轻源头的视觉隐私暴露,但仅ULR外观就实质性地限制了语义和空间理解.
因此,我们采用了一种将高分辨率深度(HR)与ULR RGB相结合的保全隐私的不对称感知环境,在限制精致的视觉信息的同时,保护密度几何。
为了解决HR深度与ULR RGB之间的严重信息不平衡,我们提出一个使用HR几何来指导语义导向的RGB重建和RGB-D分割的联合2D框架.
尽管有可靠的帧级预测,但在不对称的HR深度-ULR RGB设置下,一致的场景级理解仍然具有挑战性.
因此,我们开发了一个端到端的2D至3D管道,将2D语义特征整合为3D分割.
ScanNet上的实验显示,我们的方法在隐私保存方法中实现了最好的2D和3D分解性能,并向SUN RGB-D和ScenenNN提供了最强的零镜头传输.
隐私可回收性分析显示,我们提议的HR深度-ULR RGB输入降低了敏感数据的可回收性,而实机器人实验显示由此产生的三维语义对目标导航的实用性。

blocks.en: I INTRODUCTION
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
As mobile robots increasingly operate in human-centered environments such as homes, offices, hospitals, and care facilities, their onboard cameras may inadvertently capture user privacy data such as faces, readable text and display contents, raising user privacy concerns [ 34 ] .
Several existing approaches mitigate visual privacy risks by using
source-level ultra-low-resolution (ULR) sensing, with resolutions such as 16 × 16 16\times 16 or 16 × 12 16\times 12 pixels to restrict visual details at acquisition time [ 28 , 16 , 17 ] .
At the same time, many robotic applications, such as mapping and navigation, benefit from explicit geometry understanding of the surrounding 3D environment.
However, ULR RGB alone provides limited semantic detail and geometric information, constraining both accurate semantic perception and downstream tasks that rely on 3D scene understanding.
blocks.zh:
随着移动机器人越来越多地在家庭,办公室,医院,护理设施等以人为本的环境中运行,其机上摄像头可能会无意中捕捉到用户的隐私数据,如面部,可读文本和显示内容,引起用户的隐私关注[34].
一些现有方法通过使用
源位超低分辨率(ULR)感知,其分辨率如16×16 16\时16或16×12 16\时12像素在获取时限制视觉细节[28,16,17].
同时,许多机器人应用,如绘图和导航,都得益于对周围3D环境的清晰几何理解.
然而,仅ULR RGB提供了有限的语义细节和几何信息,既制约了准确的语义感知,又制约了依赖于3D场景理解的下游任务.

blocks.en:
Depth sensing provides direct metric structure without capturing fine-grained visual appearance, and has therefore been explored as a privacy-preserving modality for robotic perception [ 22 , 2 , 19 , 23 ] .
High-resolution (HR) depth offers dense geometry information that is naturally complementary to the coarse appearance cues retained by ULR RGB.
However, jointly exploiting these HR depth and ULR RGB for semantic perception remains largely unexplored.
Recent ULR RGB semantic segmentation has established a basis for privacy-preserving robot navigation using improved semantic predictions [ 17 ] .
We therefore propose to combine HR depth with source-level ULR RGB for privacy-preserving semantic segmentation.
Specifically, RGB observations are restricted to 16 × 12 16\times 12 pixels, while depth is retained at 640 × 480 640\times 480 , limiting fine-grained visual acquisition while preserving dense geometry information.
blocks.zh:
深度感知在不捕捉精致视觉外观的情况下提供直接的度量结构,因此作为机器人感知的一种隐私保护模式[22,2,19,23]被探索.
高分辨率(HR)深度提供密集的几何信息,这自然是对ULR RGB保留粗糙的外观提示的补充.
然而,共同利用这些人力资源深度和ULR RGB进行语义感知,基本上仍未加以探讨。
最近的 ULR RGB语义分解通过改进语义预测[17]为隐私保护机器人导航奠定了基础.
因此,我们建议将HR深度与源级ULR RGB结合,用于隐私保留语义分割.
具体来说,RGB的观测被限制在16×12 16\times 12像素,而深度则保留在640×480 640\times 480,在保存密密几何信息的同时限制精细的视觉获取.

blocks.en:
Existing RGB-D semantic segmentation methods [ 30 , 43 , 42 ] , however, typically assume RGB and depth observations at common spatial resolutions, making them unsuitable for our privacy-preserving asymmetric inputs.
This asymmetry is central to our setting: high-resolution depth provides dense spatial and geometric cues that are largely absent from ULR RGB, but effectively exploiting such complementary information requires explicitly accounting for the severe imbalance between the two modalities.
To this end, we present a novel joint-learning framework that leverages depth-conditioned visual reconstruction with RGB-D semantic learning, allowing HR geometry to guide the recovery of semantic information from ULR appearance.
To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to achieve semantic segmentation under privacy-preserving asymmetric inputs.
blocks.zh:
然而,现有的RGB-D语义分解方法[30,43,42],通常在共同的空间分辨率下假设RGB和深度观测,使它们不适合我们保持隐私的不对称输入.
这种不对称性是我们环境的核心:高分辨率深度提供了ULR RGB中大部分没有的密集空间和几何提示,但有效利用这种补充信息需要明确说明两种模式之间的严重不平衡。
为此,我们提出了一个新的联合学习框架,利用RGB-D语义学来利用深度条件的视觉重建,使HR几何学能够指导从ULR外观中恢复语义信息.
据我们所知,我们首先在保护隐私的不对称投入下实现语义分割。

blocks.en:
While accurate image-level predictions provide useful semantic cues, directly fusing them across views to 3D is insufficient under our highly asymmetric HR depth–ULR RGB setting.
We therefore develop an end-to-end 2D-to-3D pipeline that learns to consolidate the recovered frame-level semantic features into a full-scene representation for 3D semantic segmentation.
Fig. 1 illustrates a real-world privacy-preserving setting and shows how our pipeline supports semantic object-goal navigation using only HR depth and ULR RGB.
To summarize, our contributions are the following: • We propose a novel 2D semantic segmentation framework that bridges the severe information imbalance between HR depth and ULR RGB by coupling depth-conditioned visual recovery with joint RGB-D semantic learning. • We develop an end-to-end 2D-to-3D pipeline that learns to transfer and consolidate the recovered 2D semantic features under the asymmetric HR depth–ULR RGB setting for 3D semantic segmentation. • We introduce a privacy-preserving asymmetric HR depth–ULR RGB input setting, conduct a quantitative privacy evaluation of data disclosure across different inputs, and demonstrate its practical applicability through real-world robotic deployment. Our implementation will be made open-source.
blocks.zh:
虽然准确的图像水平预测提供了有用的语义提示,但是在我们高度不对称的HR深度-ULR RGB设置下,直接将视线连接到3D是不够的。
因此我们开发了端到端的2D到3D管道,学习将恢复的帧级语义特征整合为3D语义分解的全场代表.
图1显示了一个现实世界的隐私保护设置,并显示了我们的管道如何只使用HR深度和ULR RGB支持语义对象目标导航.
概括地说,我们的贡献如下: 我们提出一个新的2D语义分解框架,通过将深度条件的视觉恢复与RGB-D语义联合学习相结合,来弥补HR深度与ULR RGB之间的严重信息不平衡. ^ 我们开发一个端到端的2D至3D管道,在不对称的HR深度-ULR RGB设置下学习转移和巩固恢复的2D语义特征,用于3D语义分割. ^ 我们引入了一个保护隐私的不对称的HR深度-ULR RGB输入设置,对不同输入中的数据披露进行定量的隐私评价,并通过现实世界的机器人部署来展示其实用性. 我们的执行将开放来源。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Privacy-Preserving Visual Perception for Mobile Robots
blocks.zh: II-A 保护移动机器人的视觉感受

blocks.en: A major source of privacy exposure is HR RGB sensing, which captures not only the visual cues required for robotic perception, but also user privacy information [ 34 ] .
blocks.zh: 隐私暴露的一个主要来源是HR RGB感知,它不仅捕捉机器人感知所需的视觉提示,还捕捉用户隐私信息[34].

blocks.en:
To mitigate privacy risks, several studies avoid detailed appearance sensing by relying on geometry-centric modalities.
For example, LiDAR-based approaches have been explored for privacy-sensitive human monitoring and activity recognition in robotic settings [ 8 , 3 ] , while depth sensing has been used for privacy-preserving indoor mapping and human activity recognition [ 22 , 19 ] .
However, completely removing RGB also eliminates complementary appearance cues that are useful for semantic discrimination [ 15 ] .
blocks.zh:
为了减轻隐私风险,一些研究依靠几何-中心模式避免了详细的外观感知.
例如,在机器人环境下探索了基于LiDAR的对隐私敏感的人类监测和活动识别方法[8,3],而深度感知则用于保护隐私的室内测绘和人类活动识别[22,19].
然而,完全删除RGB也会消除对语义歧视有用的互补外观提示[15].

blocks.en:
A common direction preserves conventional RGB sensing but applies privacy protection after HR RGB image acquisition, for example, through blurring, pixelation or anonymization [ 18 , 24 , 37 ] .
Although such approaches can reduce the privacy information exposed to downstream modules or external users, the original HR images typically need to be captured before protection is applied.
Sensitive visual content may therefore still exist transiently within the sensing pipeline or processing buffers, which raise privacy risks in networked robotic systems [ 29 ] .
blocks.zh:
一个共同的方向保留了常规的RGB感知,但在HR RGB图像获取后适用隐私保护,例如通过模糊,像素化或匿名化[18,24,37].
虽然这类方法可以减少下游模块或外部用户暴露的隐私信息,但最初的HR图像通常需要在应用保护之前被捕获.
因此,敏感视觉内容在感知管道或加工缓冲器中可能仍然短暂存在,这在联网的机器人系统中造成了隐私风险[29].

blocks.en:
A complementary strategy enforces privacy directly at the sensing stage by minimizing visual information acquisition.
ULR sensing restricts spatial RGB detail at capture time, rather than first recording an HR image and sanitizing it afterward.
Privacy-preserving activity recognition has been demonstrated using RGB inputs as low as 16 × 12 16\times 12 pixels [ 28 ] ,
while a recent user study identified resolutions around 16 × 16 16\times 16 as a favorable privacy–utility operating point [ 17 ] .
More recently, ULR imagery ( 16 × 16 16\times 16 ) has also been explored for privacy-preserving 2D semantic segmentation [ 17 ] .
Although these methods reduce privacy exposure at the source, ULR RGB alone suffers from substantial loss of spatial details and appearance cues, constraining semantic accuracy and its utility for downstream robotic tasks.
blocks.zh:
辅助策略通过尽量减少视觉信息的获取,在感知阶段直接实现隐私.
ULR感知在捕捉时间限制空间RGB细节,而不是首先记录一个HR图像,然后将其消毒.
使用 RGB 输入的隐私保存活动识别已被演示为低至 16× 12 16\时 12 像素 [28],
最近的一项用户研究将16×16 16\时16左右的分辨率确定为有利的隐私-实用操作点[17]。
最近,ULR图像(16×16 16\times 16 )也被探索用于保护隐私的2D语义分区[17].
虽然这些方法降低了源头的隐私暴露,但仅ULR RGB就受到空间细节和外观提示的巨大损失,限制了语义精度及其对下游机器人任务的实用性.

blocks.en: These limitations motivate the asymmetric input configuration in this work: HR depth preserves fine-grained geometry structures, while ULR RGB provides coarse appearance cues.
blocks.zh: 这些限制刺激了这项工作中的不对称输入配置: HR深度保留精细的几何结构,而ULR RGB则提供粗糙的外观提示.

blocks.en: II-B Semantic Segmentation
blocks.zh: II-B 语义分裂

blocks.en: Under the privacy-preserving asymmetric RGB-D setting, a central question is how to recover accurate semantic segmentation from severe information imbalance.
blocks.zh: 在保持隐私的不对称RGB-D设置下,一个中心的问题是如何从严重的信息不平衡中恢复准确的语义分裂.

blocks.en:
2D Semantic Segmentation. At the image level, RGB-D semantic segmentation has been widely studied to exploit the complementary information provided by color and depth.
Existing approaches broadly range from CNN-based feature fusion [ 10 , 26 , 30 ] to adaptive cross-modal fusion with gating or attention [ 46 , 45 ] , and more recent transformer-based or joint RGB-D representation learning methods [ 43 , 42 , 41 ] .
However, these methods generally assume access to HR RGB observations, leaving their effectiveness unclear when RGB is severely constrained.
Recent ULR semantic segmentation work has explored semantic prediction from severely resolution-constrained RGB inputs [ 17 ] , but treats RGB as the sole sensing modality.
Existing RGB-D and ULR semantic segmentation therefore address complementary settings: the former leverages depth cues but assumes rich RGB input, whereas the latter constrains RGB resolution without exploiting geometry information.
Their intersection, semantic segmentation from ULR RGB and HR depth, remains underexplored.
blocks.zh:
2D语义分裂. 在图像层面,RGB-D语义分解被广泛研究,以利用颜色和深度提供的补充信息.
现有方法的范围很广,从基于CNN的特性聚变[10,26,30],到适应性跨模式聚变,并带有吉卜赛语或注意力[46,45],以及更近的基于变压器或联合RGB-D的表达学习方法[43,42,41].
然而,这些方法一般假定可以获取HR RGB的观察结果,使其有效性在RGB受到严重限制时变得不明确.
最近的ULR语义分解工作从严重分辨率约束的RGB输入中探索了语义预测[17],但将RGB视为唯一的感知模式.
因此,现有的RGB-D和ULR语义分割处理互补设置:前者利用深度提示,但假设丰富的RGB输入,而后者不利用几何信息而限制RGB分辨率.
它们从ULR RGB和HR深度的交汇,语义分解,仍然没有得到充分的探讨.

blocks.en:
3D Semantic Segmentation. Image-space semantics are inherently view dependent and lack persistent metric localization, which limits their applicability to downstream robotic tasks.
Geometry-only 3D semantic segmentation addresses this limitation by reasoning directly over point clouds, voxels or meshes, exploiting spatial structure and neighborhood context for semantic prediction [ 13 , 12 ] .
Despite strong geometry reasoning capabilities, geometry alone may remain ambiguous for semantically distinct categories with similar shapes or spatial configurations [ 15 ] .
blocks.zh:
3D语义分裂. 图像空间语义在本质上依赖视图,缺乏持续的度量本地化,这限制了其对下游机器人任务的应用.
仅几何的三维语义分解通过直接在点云,阴极或间隙上进行推理,利用空间结构和邻里背景来进行语义预测[13,12]来解决这一局限性.
尽管有很强的几何推理能力,但对于形状或空间布局相似的类,仅几何本身可能仍然模糊不清[15].

blocks.en:
Appearance information can complement geometry representations.
A common strategy directly augments 3D points or voxels with RGB attributes [ 25 , 21 ] , while other methods extract learned image features and project them into 3D, demonstrating the benefit of richer 2D representations over naive color fusion [ 7 , 20 ] .
Subsequent approaches further exploit cross-view evidence through learned multi-view aggregation or bidirectional 2D–3D interaction, or visual-to-3D knowledge transfer [ 27 , 38 , 4 ] .
blocks.zh:
外观信息可以补充几何表达.
共同策略直接增强具有RGB属性的3D点或voxels[25,21],而其他方法则提取学到的图像特征并投影到3D中,显示出较丰富的2D表示比天真色聚[7,20]的好处.
后续方法通过学到的多视图聚合或双向2D-3D相互作用,或视觉到3D的知识转让[27、38、4],进一步利用交叉视图证据。

blocks.en:
However, existing 2D to 3D approaches typically rely on semantic features extracted from HR RGB imagery.
Building on this asymmetric RGB-D setting, it remains unclear whether the recovered semantic representations can be effectively transferred and consolidated across views in 3D.
We therefore aim to address this gap by lifting the 2D semantics into metric 3D for full-scene semantic segmentation.
blocks.zh:
然而,现有的2D到3D方法一般依赖于从HR RGB图像中提取的语义特征.
基于这种不对称的RGB-D设置,仍然不清楚恢复的语义表述是否能够在3D中有效转移和整合各种观点.
因此,我们的目标是解决这一差距,将2D语义提高到全场语义分解的3D度。

blocks.en:
Fig. 2 : Overview of our joint 2D semantic segmentation framework.
Given ULR RGB and HR depth inputs, a shared depth encoder extracts hierarchical geometry features that both condition the semantic-oriented super-resolution branch and support subsequent RGB-D semantic segmentation together with the reconstructed RGB representation.
blocks.zh:
图2:我们联合2D语义分解框架概述.
鉴于ULR RGB和HR深度输入,一个共享的深度编码器提取了分级几何特征,既能对语义导向的超分辨率分支进行条件化,又能支持随后的RGB-D语义分割,再加上重建后的RGB代表.

blocks.en: III Our Approach
blocks.zh: 三. 我们的方针

blocks.en: III-A 2D Semantic Segmentation Framework
blocks.zh: 2D 语义分解框架

blocks.en: III-A 1 Framework Overview
blocks.zh: 框架概览

blocks.en:
We consider a highly asymmetric RGB-D sensing configuration, where an HR depth map of 640 × 480 640\times 480 is paired with a ULR RGB image of 16 × 12 16\times 12 .
To address the severe information imbalance between the two modalities, we formulate super-resolution (SR) and semantic segmentation (SS) as a joint learning problem rather than two independent stages.
As illustrated in Fig. 2 , our framework consists of a shared depth encoder, a depth-conditioned SR branch, and an RGB-D semantic segmentation branch.
The depth encoder extracts high-resolution geometry features that condition RGB reconstruction and are also incorporated into semantic prediction.
The reconstructed appearance and depth representations are then jointly used to produce the final semantic mask.
By jointly optimizing SR and segmentation, the framework encourages the recovered RGB representation to preserve task-relevant semantic information rather than serving reconstruction alone.
blocks.zh:
我们认为是一种高度不对称的RGB-D感应配置,其中640×480 640\时的HR深度图与16×12 16\时的ULR RGB图像成对.
为了解决两种方式之间的严重信息不平衡,我们把超解(SR)和语义分割(SS)作为一个共同学习问题,而不是两个独立的阶段。
如图2所示,我们的框架包括一个共享的深度编码器、一个深度有条件的SR分支和一个RGB-D语义分区分支。
深度编码器提取了高分辨率几何特征,这些特征为RGB重建提供了条件,并且也被纳入语义预测.
重建后的外观和深度表现随后共同用于产生最终的语义面具.
该框架通过共同优化SR和分割,鼓励恢复的RGB代表保存与任务相关的语义信息,而不是仅服务于重建.

blocks.en: III-A 2 Shared Depth Encoder
blocks.zh: III-A 2 共享深度编码器

blocks.en:
Under the highly asymmetric RGB-D setting, the ULR RGB input loses substantial spatial structure, whereas the HR depth map preserves rich geometry but may contain locally unreliable measurements and irregular discontinuities.
To effectively exploit this complementary modality, we adopt a Deformable Attention Transformer (DAT) [ 40 ] as the shared depth encoder.
Unlike fixed-grid attention, DAT adaptively selects key–value sampling locations in a data-dependent manner, enabling the encoder to focus on informative geometry structures and aggregate context beyond locally unreliable regions.
This makes it suitable for our privacy-constrained input setting to extract reliable geometry cues from HR depth to compensate for the severe spatial information loss in ULR RGB.

For SS, these features serve as stage-wise depth representations for multi-scale RGB-D feature fusion.

The generated image serves as a task-oriented intermediate representation for semantic segmentation, while limiting perceptually recognizable privacy leakage, consistent with prior findings on reconstruction-based privacy assessment [ 33 ] .

To jointly optimize the reconstructed RGB for downstream semantic segmentation, we adopt DeepLabV3 with ResNet-101 [ 5 ] .
Although SR recovers a denser RGB representation, the extreme degradation of the ULR input leaves semantic ambiguities that cannot be reliably recovered from RGB alone.
To further exploit HR geometry for semantic segmentation, we perform stage-wise RGB-D feature fusion between the multi-scale RGB features { F i r } i = 1 4 \{F_{i}^{r}\}_{i=1}^{4} and the corresponding depth features { F i d } i = 1 4 \{F_{i}^{d}\}_{i=1}^{4} : F i r ​ d = ℱ i ( F i r , F i d , D i HR ) , i = 1 , … , 4 F_{i}^{rd}=\mathcal{F}_{i}\left(F_{i}^{r},F_{i}^{d},D_{i}^{\mathrm{HR}}\right),i=1,\ldots,4 .
Here, ℱ i ​ ( ⋅ ) \mathcal{F}_{i}(\cdot) denotes the geometry-guided RGB-D fusion at stage i i , with D i HR D_{i}^{\mathrm{HR}} spatially aligned to the corresponding feature resolution. The depth feature is projected and jointly rectified with the RGB feature through channel- and spatial-wise cross-modal weighting, followed by geometry-guided self-attention.

Fig. 3 : Overview of our 2D-to-3D semantic segmentation pipeline.
Given multi-view ULR RGB and HR depth observations, the frozen 2D framework first extracts frame-level semantic representations.
These representations are geometrically lifted into a common 3D space, aggregated across views, and refined by a geometry-semantic sparse 3D network to produce the final 3D semantic scene prediction.
The pipeline enables spatially consistent scene-level semantic understanding under the privacy-preserving HR depth–ULR RGB sensing configuration.

在保护隐私的HR深度-ULR RGB传感器配置下,该管道能够使空间一致的场景级语义理解。

blocks.en: III-B 2D-To-3D Semantic Segmentation Pipeline
blocks.zh: III-B 2D-to-3D 语义分解管道

blocks.en: III-B 1 Pipeline Overview
blocks.zh: 三-B 1 管道概况

blocks.en:
Under the privacy-preserving HR depth–ULR RGB setting, our proposed framework produces reliable frame-level semantic representations but cannot explicitly capture multi-view consistency and scene-level 3D context.
We therefore develop an end-to-end 2D-to-3D semantic pipeline that lifts 2D semantic evidence into a unified 3D space and performs geometry-semantic reasoning with a sparse 3D network.
As illustrated in Fig. 3 , our frozen 2D network takes the ULR RGB images and corresponding HR depth maps to extract pixel-wise semantic evidence.
We then build an end-to-end 2D-to-3D semantic prediction pipeline that lifts this evidence into a unified 3D voxel space, aggregates observations across multiple views, and performs geometry-semantic reasoning with a learnable sparse 3D network to produce the final 3D semantic prediction.
In this way, HR depth provides both geometry guidance for 2D perception and the spatial correspondence required to transfer semantic evidence from image space to 3D.
blocks.zh:
在保护隐私的 HR 深度 – ULR RGB 设置下,我们拟议的框架会产生可靠的帧级语义表达,但不能明确地捕捉多视图一致性和场景级3D上下文.
因此,我们开发了一个端对端的2D至3D语义管道,将2D语义证据提升到一个统一的3D空间,并以一个稀少的3D网络进行几何语义推理.
如图3所示,我们被冻结的2D网络采集ULR RGB图像和相应的HR深度图,以提取像素-智慧语义证据.
然后,我们建造一个端到端的2D到3D语义预测管道,将这种证据提升到一个统一的3D Voxel空间,将各种观点的观测结果聚合在一起,并用可学习的稀疏的3D网络进行几何语义推理,以产生最终的3D语义预测.
这样,HR深度既为2D感知提供了几何指导,也提供了将语义证据从图像空间转移到3D所需的空间通信.

blocks.en: III-B 2 Geometry-Aligned Feature Lifting
blocks.zh: III-B 2 几何-相交地物提升

blocks.en:
For each frame t t , the frozen 2D model provides the pixel-wise class probability p t ​ ( u ) p_{t}(u) and the pre-classifier decoder feature F t 2 ​ D ​ ( u ) F_{t}^{2D}(u) .
A trainable feature adapter first maps the decoder feature to a compact semantic representation f t ​ ( u ) = A θ ​ ( F t 2 ​ D ​ ( u ) ) . f_{t}(u)=A_{\theta}\!\left(F_{t}^{2D}(u)\right). Each pixel is then back-projected into world space and associated with its canonical 3D voxel.
For each voxel, we retain the mean and variation of lifted semantic features, mean class probability, prediction uncertainty and agreement, and observation statistics.
These 2D semantic cues are further combined with local 3D geometry, ULR color, and observation validity to form the final voxel representation.

这些2D语义提示与本地的3D几何,ULR颜色和观测有效性进一步结合,形成最终的voxel代表.

blocks.en: III-B 3 Geometry-Semantic Sparse 3D Refinement
blocks.zh: III-B 3 几何语义 3D 改进

blocks.en:
Although 2D lifting aligns multi-view semantic evidence in a common 3D space, the aggregated voxel representations may still contain ambiguities caused by the severely degraded ULR appearance and inconsistent observations.
We therefore introduce a geometry-semantic 3D refinement module to explicitly reason over spatial context in 3D.
We employ a sparse residual 3D U-Net [ 9 ] to efficiently capture hierarchical geometric and semantic context while preserving fine-grained voxel structure.
Given the lifted voxel representation X i 3 ​ D X_{i}^{3D} , the refinement network directly predicts voxel-wise semantic logits as z i = R ψ ​ ( X i 3 ​ D ) z_{i}=R_{\psi}\!\left(X_{i}^{3D}\right) .
This 3D reasoning stage enables the model to refine ambiguous multi-view evidence and propagate semantic context to observed regions.

因此,我们引入了一个几何-语义3D改进模块,以便在3D中明确解释空间背景。
我们使用一个稀疏的3D U-Net [9] 来有效捕捉层次几何和语义背景,同时保留精细的葡萄酒结构.
鉴于已解除的 voxel 表示 X i 3 D X_{i}^{3D },完善网络直接预测 voxel 明智的语义逻辑为 z i = R ψ ( X i 3 D ) 右转!
这个三维推理阶段使模型能够完善模棱两可的多视图证据,并向观察到的区域传播语义背景.

blocks.en: III-B 4 3D Training Objective
blocks.zh: 3D 培训目标

blocks.en:
During 3D training, the pretrained 2D frontend remains frozen, while the feature adapter and sparse 3D refinement network are jointly optimized by the final 3D semantic objective.

blocks.en: IV Experiments
blocks.zh: 四 试验

blocks.en:
We evaluate our framework on both 2D and 3D semantic segmentation under two sensing regimes.
The non-private setting assumes access to HR RGB together with HR depth, whereas the privacy-preserving setting prohibits access to HR RGB and uses only ULR RGB, HR depth, or their combination.

我们在两种感知系统下评估我们的二维和三维语义分解框架。
非私人设置假定与HR深度一起访问HR RGB,而隐私保护设置则禁止访问HR RGB,只使用ULR RGB,HR深度,或其组合.

blocks.en: IV-A 2D Semantic Segmentation
blocks.zh: IV-A 2D 语义分裂

blocks.en: IV-A 1 Datasets
blocks.zh: IV-A 1 数据集

blocks.en:
We train our 2D framework on ScanNet [ 6 ] , a
large-scale RGB-D benchmark of indoor scenes. Following
the official split, we use 1,201 scenes for training and 312 scenes for validation.
For each RGB-D frame, the RGB image is cropped to 640 × 480 640\times 480 and bicubically downsampled to 16 × 12 16\times 12 to simulate source-level ULR RGB input following [ 28 ] .
The corresponding depth map is retained at 640 × 480 640\times 480 , yielding the privacy-preserving asymmetric HR depth–ULR RGB input used throughout the 2D experiments.

室内场景的大型RGB-D基准. 接下来
我们用1,201幕来训练 和312幕来验证
对于每个RGB-D帧,RGB图像被裁剪为640×480 640\时,并双向下取样为16×12 16\时,以模拟[28]之后的源级ULR RGB输入.

blocks.en: IV-A 2 Baselines
blocks.zh: 基线

blocks.en:
For the non-private setting, we use DFormerV2 [ 41 ] with HR RGB-D input as a strong RGB-D semantic segmentation baseline.
Under the privacy-preserving setting, we first consider two single-modality baselines:
ULRSS [ 17 ] using only ULR RGB, and DeepLabV3 [ 5 ] using only HR depth.
For the asymmetric HR depth–ULR RGB input, we further evaluate DFormerV2 under two training protocols:
(i) trained on standard HR RGB-D and directly evaluated on HR depth–ULR RGB, and
(ii) the same architecture trained using HR depth–ULR RGB.
These comparisons assess both the effect of the sensing constraint and the benefit of adapting RGB-D segmentation to the proposed privacy-preserving asymmetric input configuration.
Unless otherwise specified, all privacy-preserving baselines use the same inputs as ours, with HR depth at 640 × 480 640\times 480 and/or ULR RGB at 16 × 12 16\times 12 .
blocks.zh:
对于非私有设置,我们使用带有HR RGB-D输入的DFormerV2[41]作为强大的RGB-D语义分解基线.
根据保护隐私的设定,我们首先考虑两个单一模式基线:
ULRSS [17] 仅使用ULR RGB,而DeepLabV3 [5] 仅使用HR深度.
对于不对称的HR深度-ULR RGB输入,我们进一步根据两个训练协议评价DFormerV2:
(一) 培训关于标准的人力资源RGB-D,直接评价关于人力资源深度-ULR RGB,
(二) 使用HR深度-ULR RGB培训的同一架构。
这些比较既评估了感知约束的影响,也评估了使RGB-D分解适应拟议的隐私保留不对称输入配置的好处.
除非另有说明,所有保护隐私的基线使用与我们相同的输入,人力资源深度为640×480 640\时和/或ULR RGB为16×12 16\时。

blocks.en: IV-A 3 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 执行细节

blocks.en:
The SR employs ℓ 1 \ell_{1} reconstruction losses at the full resolution of 640 × 480 640\times 480 and an auxiliary half resolution of 320 × 240 320\times 240 , weighted by λ r1 \lambda_{\mathrm{r1}} : 1.0 1.0 and λ r2 \lambda_{\mathrm{r2}} : 0.5 0.5 .
For semantic supervision, we use cross-entropy with label smoothing of 0.01 0.01 , together with Dice, Lovász, and boundary losses weighted by 0.05 0.05 , 0.2 0.2 , and 0.1 0.1 .
The auxiliary segmentation head is weighted by 0.4 0.4 , and the overall segmentation objective by 0.1 0.1 .
The 2D framework has an inference time of 0.37 s per image.

blocks.zh: IV-A 4 评价议定书和计量

blocks.en:
We evaluate in-domain performance on the ScanNet validation set.
We further evaluate the zero-shot generalization ability of our 2D framework on SUN RGB-D test set [ 31 ] , which contains 5,050 images, without fine-tuning.

blocks.en: IV-A 5 Results
blocks.zh: 四-A 5 结果

blocks.en: Table I shows 2D semantic segmentation results on both ScanNet validation set and SUN RGB-D zero-shot benchmark under different input settings.
blocks.zh: 表一显示不同输入设置下ScanNet验证集和SUN RGB-D零瞄准基准的2D语义分区结果.

blocks.en:
ScanNet-2D Validation. Despite operating without access to HR RGB, our method achieves performance comparable to the non-private HR RGB-D reference, demonstrating that strong semantic utility can be retained under the proposed privacy-preserving sensing configuration.
More importantly, the comparison among privacy-preserving inputs reveals the complementary roles of geometry and appearance. ULR RGB alone provides limited semantic utility, whereas HR depth offers a much stronger structural basis when fine-grained RGB appearance is unavailable.
However, simply combining the two modalities with DFormerV2 does not translate this complementarity into improved performance: even after retraining on the same asymmetric HR depth–ULR RGB input, it remains substantially below the depth-only baseline.
In contrast, our framework improves upon HR depth alone, indicating that explicitly accounting for the severe modality asymmetry enables the remaining coarse appearance cues in ULR RGB to effectively complement high-resolution geometry.
blocks.zh:
扫描网-2D 鉴定. 尽管操作时无法访问HR RGB,但我们的方法实现了与非私有的HR RGB-D参考相比的性能,表明强大的语义功能可以在拟议的隐私保护感知配置下保留.
更重要的是,保护隐私投入之间的比较揭示了几何和外观的互补作用. 仅ULR RGB就提供了有限的语义用法,而当没有精细的RGB外观时,HR深度则提供了更强大的结构基础.
然而,简单地将两种模式与DFormerV2合并并不能将这种互补性转化为更好的性能:即使在以相同的不对称的HR深度-ULR RGB输入进行再培训之后,它仍然大大低于仅限深度的基准。
相比之下,我们的框架仅在人力资源深度方面有所改进,这表明,明确说明严重模式不对称使得ULR RGB中剩余的粗糙外观提示能够有效补充高分辨率几何。

blocks.en:
Zero-Shot Generalization on SUN RGB-D. The same trend persists under cross-dataset transfer.
ULR RGB alone generalizes poorly, whereas HR depth transfers more robustly, supporting the greater cross-domain stability of geometric structure.
Our method further improves upon the depth-only baseline, showing that the coarse appearance retained by ULR RGB remains complementary even under domain shift when integrated through our asymmetric framework.
Fig. 4 provides a qualitative example of this effect: the depth-only baseline confuses the table with another furniture category, while our prediction preserves the correct semantic distinction.
In contrast, DFormerV2 trained on the same HR depth–ULR RGB input remains clearly inferior, again indicating that conventional RGB-D fusion does not effectively exploit the highly imbalanced modalities.
Although a gap remains to the non-private HR RGB-D reference, our method achieves the strongest zero-shot generalization among all privacy-preserving approaches.
blocks.zh:
(原始内容存档于2017-09-21). Zero-Shot Generation on SUN RGB-D. 在跨数据集传输方面,这一趋势依然存在。
ULR RGB单是概括性差,而人力资源深度转移则更有力,支持几何结构更大的跨域稳定性。
我们的方法在只有深度的基线上进一步改进,表明ULR RGB保留的粗糙外观即使在通过我们不对称的框架进行整合时仍能互补。
图4提供了这一效应的一个定性例子:仅深度基线将表格与另一个家具类别混淆,而我们的预测则保留了正确的语义区分.
相比之下,在相同的HR深度-ULR RGB输入上接受的DFormerV2仍然明显低劣,再次表明常规RGB-D聚变不能有效地利用高度不平衡的模式.
虽然对于非私人的HR RGB-D参考仍有差距,但我们的方法在所有的隐私保护方法中实现了最强的零镜头概括.

blocks.en: IV-B 3D Semantic Segmentation
blocks.zh: IV-B 3D 语义分裂

blocks.en: IV-B 1 Datasets
blocks.zh: IV-B 1 数据集

blocks.en: For 3D semantic segmentation, we use the same ScanNet training and validation splits as in the 2D experiments, with evaluation performed on the corresponding 3D scene representations.
blocks.zh: 对于3D语义分解,我们使用与2D实验相同的ScanNet培训和验证分解,在相应的3D场景表现上进行评价.

blocks.en: IV-B 2 Baselines
blocks.zh: 基线

blocks.en:
For the non-private setting, we use PTv3 [ 39 ] on the 3D scene representation constructed from HR RGB-D observations as a strong 3D semantic segmentation baseline.
For privacy-preserving evaluation, the 2D baselines are extended to 3D through a common multi-view fusion procedure: per-view semantic probabilities are projected onto visible mesh vertices and aggregated across views according to prediction confidence, depth consistency, and viewing angle.
This procedure is applied to ULRSS, depth-only DeepLabV3, and both DFormerV2 variants.
We additionally train PTv3 directly on the 3D representation constructed under the HR depth–ULR RGB sensing setting, providing an end-to-end 3D baseline under the same privacy constraint.
blocks.zh:
对于非私人设置,我们用PTv3[39]在从HR RGB-D观测中构建的3D场景代表物上作为强力的3D语义分解基线.
就保护隐私的评价而言,2D基线通过共同的多视图聚变程序延长至3D:将每个视图的语义概率投射到可见的网格顶点上,并根据预测的自信、深度一致性和视角汇总各种观点。
这个程序适用于ULRSS,只有深度的DeepLabV3以及DFormerV2两个变体.
我们通过在 HR 深度- ULR RGB 感知设置下构建的 3D 表示方式, 直接进行 PTv3 的列车, 在同一隐私限制下提供 端到端的 3D 基线 。

TABLE II : 3D semantic segmentation performance on ScanNet-3D and zero-shot evaluation on SceneNN under different sensing settings.
As can be seen, our method achieves the strongest segmentation performance among the privacy-preserving approaches on ScanNet-3D and maintains the best zero-shot generalization to SceneNN.
blocks.zh:
表二:ScanNet-3D上的3D语义分解性能,以及不同遥感环境下SceneN的零镜头评价.
可以看出,我们的方法在ScanNet-3D上的隐私保存方法中实现了最强的分解性能,并保持了对SceneNN的最佳零射一般化.

blocks.en:

Compared with the strongest privacy-preserving baseline PTv3, which misclassifies a chair as sofa, our method preserves the correct semantic category, illustrating the benefit of incorporating lifted 2D semantic evidence into scene-level 3D reasoning.

与最强的隐私保护基线PTv3相比,它把椅子误归类为沙发,我们的方法保留了正确的语义类,说明了将解除的2D语义证据纳入场景级3D推理的好处.

blocks.en: IV-B 3 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 四-B 3 执行细节

blocks.en:
We employ mixed-precision training, and clip the global gradient norm to 1.0.
The 3D pipeline has a scene-level inference time of approximately 1.4 s per scene.

blocks.en: IV-B 4 Evaluation Protocol and Metrics
blocks.zh: IV-B 4 评价协议和计量

blocks.en:
We evaluate in-domain 3D semantic segmentation on the ScanNet validation set.
To assess cross-dataset generalization, we further perform zero-shot evaluation on SceneNN [ 11 ] without fine-tuning.
We follow prior cross-dataset evaluation protocols of [ 14 ] on SceneNN.
After filtering scenes with incomplete RGB-D data, we retain 46 scenes for evaluation.
Since 17 SceneNN categories overlap with the ScanNet 20-class taxonomy, evaluation is performed over these shared classes.
We report 3D mIoU and 3D mAcc over mesh vertices.
blocks.zh:
我们在ScanNet验证组上评估域内3D语义分区.
为了评估跨数据集的概括性,我们进一步在SceneNN[11]上进行零镜头评价,而不进行微调.
我们遵循SceneNN上[14]的交叉数据集评价协议。
使用不完整的RGB-D数据过滤场景后,我们保留了46场景进行评价.
自17场戏以来 NN类别与ScanNet20级分类重叠,对这些共享类别进行评价。
我们报告3D mIoU和3D mAcc在网状顶部。

blocks.en: IV-B 5 Results
blocks.zh: IV-B 5 结果

blocks.en: Table II reports 3D semantic segmentation performance on ScanNet-3D and zero-shot generalization to SceneNN under different sensing settings.
blocks.zh: 表二汇报了ScanNet-3D上的3D语义分解性能,以及不同感知环境下对SceneNN的零射一般化.

blocks.en:
ScanNet-3D Validation. The non-private PTv3 baseline with access to HR RGB provides the strongest reference performance.
Despite operating without HR RGB, our method retains strong 3D semantic segmentation performance and is close to this non-private reference.
Among the privacy-preserving baselines, HR depth provides substantially stronger 3D semantics than ULR RGB alone, highlighting the importance of geometry information for scene-level segmentation.
For the combined HR depth–ULR RGB input, retraining DFormerV2 mitigates the input mismatch of directly using HR-trained DFormerV2, but still yields limited 3D performance, indicating that post-hoc 2D-to-3D fusion is insufficient under this highly asymmetric setting.
Direct 3D learning with PTv3 provides a considerably stronger baseline, while our end-to-end 2D-to-3D pipeline achieves the best performance under the privacy-preserving asymmetric input setting by learning how to transfer and consolidate the recovered 2D semantic features in 3D.
blocks.zh:
扫描网-3D 鉴定. 访问HR RGB的非私有PTv3基线提供了最强的参考性能.
尽管没有HR RGB操作,但我们的方法保留了强大的3D语义分解性能,并接近于这种非私人参考.
在保护隐私的基线中,HR深度提供了比仅ULR RGB更强得多的三维语义,突出了几何信息对场景层分割的重要性.
对于合并的HR深度–ULR RGB输入,再培训DFormerV2减轻了直接使用HR训练的DFormerV2的输入不匹配,但仍然产生有限的3D性能,表明在这种高度不对称的设定下,Hoc 2D到3D后聚变是不够的.
直接使用PTv3的3D学习提供了相当强的基线,而我们的端到端的2D至3D管道通过学习如何转移和整合3D中恢复的2D语义特征,在隐私保存不对称输入设置下实现了最佳性能.

blocks.en:
TABLE III : Ablation study on the ScanNet-3D validation set.
Our proposed full model achieves the best 3D semantic segmentation performance, confirming the effectiveness of both components.
blocks.zh:
表三:关于ScanNet-3D验证装置的研究。
我们提议的完整模型实现了最好的3D语义分解性能,证实了两个组件的有效性.

blocks.en:
Zero-Shot Generalization on SceneNN. We further evaluate cross-dataset generalization by directly transferring all trained models to SceneNN without fine-tuning.
Under the privacy-preserving setting, HR depth generalizes better than ULR RGB alone, indicating that geometry structure provides a more stable cue across indoor domains under the privacy-preserving setting.
For the combined HR depth–ULR RGB input, 2D-to-3D fusion baselines remain sensitive to domain shift.
In contrast, direct learned 3D reasoning with PTv3 yields a large improvement compared to non-end-to-end baselines.
Fig. 5 further illustrates local semantic ambiguities in PTv3, such as confusing a chair with a sofa, whereas our method preserves the correct category.
By explicitly lifting 2D semantic representations and integrating them with geometric context in 3D, our framework achieves the best zero-shot performance among the privacy-preserving approaches.
blocks.zh:
(原始内容存档于2017-09-26). Zero-Shot Generation on SceneNN. 我们通过直接将所有训练有素的模型转移到ScenenNN而不进行微调,进一步评价跨数据集概括.
在保护隐私的设定下,HR深度的概括性优于仅ULR RGB,表明几何结构在保护隐私的设定下提供了更稳定的跨室内域提示.
对于合并的HR深度–ULR RGB输入,2D到3D的聚变基线仍然对域位移敏感.
相比之下,直接学习的与PTv3的3D推理相比,与非端对端基线相比,得到了很大的改进.
图5进一步说明了PTv3中的当地语义模糊,例如把椅子和沙发混淆起来,而我们的方法保留了正确的类别。
通过明确解除2D语义表达,并将其与3D中的几何上下文结合,我们的框架在隐私保护方法中实现了最佳的零镜头性能.

blocks.en:
Ablation Study. Table III evaluates the contribution of each component in our pipeline. Ours-w/o Feature Lifting removes the learned 2D-to-3D feature lifting, while Ours-w/o 3D Refinement removes the 3D refinement module. Ours-w/o Both uses a non-end-to-end pipeline, where frame-level 2D predictions are fused into 3D following the procedure in Sec. IV-B2 .
Removing either feature lifting or 3D refinement degrades performance.
Notably, feature lifting without 3D refinement performs even worse than the multi-view fusion baseline, indicating that the transferred 2D features require learned 3D context to resolve cross-view inconsistency and local ambiguity.
Our full model achieves the best performance, demonstrating the complementary roles of 2D feature transfer and 3D refinement.
blocks.zh:
校勘研究. 表三评价了我们管道中每个组成部分的贡献。 Ours-w/o Feature Leading移除了学习到的2D到3D特性提升,而Ours-w/o 3D Finalment移除了3D的完善模块. 我们的 -w/o 两者均使用非端对端管道,其帧级2D预测按照Sec. IV-B2中的程序被熔化为3D.
删除特性提升或3D精细可降低性能。
值得注意的是,没有3D精细化的特性提升,其性能甚至比多视图聚变基线更差,表明转移的2D特性需要学习的3D上下文来解决交叉视图不一致和局部模糊.
我们的完整模型实现了最佳的性能,展示了2D特性转移和3D改进的互补作用.

blocks.en: IV-C Privacy Recoverability Analysis
blocks.zh: IV-C 隐私可回收性分析

blocks.en:
Following [ 15 ] , we assess potential data disclosure by analyzing the recoverability of sensitive information from each sensing modality.
We collect a small dataset of 80 images covering four privacy-sensitive categories: credit card, passport, private chat, and face, with 20 images per category.
Text recoverability is evaluated on the first three categories (60 images), while appearance recoverability is evaluated on the passport and face subsets (40 images).
We compare five different inputs: HR RGB, HR depth, ULR RGB, matched SR and shuffled SR.
Matched SR is reconstructed using the corresponding input pair, whereas shuffled SR uses a mismatched pair from another sample.
blocks.zh:
在[15]之后,我们通过分析每种感知方式的敏感信息的可回收性来评估潜在的数据披露。
我们收集了80幅图像的小型数据集,涵盖4个对隐私敏感的类别:信用卡、护照、私人聊天和脸部,每个类别20幅图像。
文本可回收性在前三类(60幅图像)上评价,而外观可回收性在护照和面部子集上评价(40幅图像)。
我们比较了五个不同的输入:HR RGB,HR深度,ULR RGB,匹配SR和shuffled SR.
匹配的SR是使用相应的输入对重建的,而shuffled SR则使用另一个样本中的不匹配对.

blocks.en: IV-C 1 Sensitive Text Recoverability
blocks.zh: IV-C 1 敏感文本可回收性

blocks.en:
We use PP-OCRv6_medium [ 44 ] with a confidence threshold of 0.95 and evaluate both exact text recovery and character-level similarity.
As shown in Table IV(a) , HR RGB retains substantial readable text, with 331 of 384 detected text instances recovered correctly.
In contrast, HR depth, ULR RGB, and both SR variants recover no text exactly.
Their character-level similarities also remain negligible, and the small gap between matched and shuffled SR indicates that reconstruction does not meaningfully recover sample-specific textual information.
blocks.zh:
我们使用PP-OCRv6_中 [44],置信阈值为0.95,并评价准确的文本恢复和字符级的相似性.
如表四(a)所示,HR RGB保留了大量可读文本,在检测到的384个文本实例中,有331个正确恢复.
相比之下,HR深度,ULR RGB,以及两个SR变体都没有完全恢复文本.
它们的性格层面的相似性也仍然微不足道,匹配和洗涤的SR之间的小差距表明重建无法有意义地恢复特定样本的文字信息.

blocks.en: IV-C 2 Appearance Attribute Recoverability
blocks.zh: IV-C 2 外观属性可回收性

blocks.en:
We further follow [ 15 ] and use Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ 1 ] to predict privacy-sensitive appearance attributes, including hair color, iris color, and eyeglass presence.
We report the macro accuracy across the three attributes.
As shown in Table IV(b) , HR RGB retains strong appearance information, achieving 95.0% accuracy, whereas both HR depth and ULR RGB yield 0.0%.
The marginal difference between matched and shuffled SR indicates that the reconstruction recovers little sample-specific appearance information related to the true privacy attributes.
These results indicate that the proposed HR depth–ULR RGB input substantially reduces recoverability of both textual and appearance information relative to HR RGB sensing.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步跟踪[15],并使用Qune3-VL-8B-指示[1]来预测对隐私敏感的外观属性,包括头发颜色,虹膜颜色,以及眼镜的存在.
我们报告这三个属性的宏观准确性。
如表四(b)所示,HR RGB保留了强烈的外观信息,达到95.0%的准确度,而HR深度和ULR RGB均达到0.0 %.
配对和洗牌SR的边际差异表明,重建恢复了与真实隐私属性相关的很少样本特定外观信息.
这些结果表明,提议的HR深度-ULR RGB输入大大降低了与HR RGB感知有关的文字和外观信息的可回收性。

blocks.en: IV-D Semantic Object-Goal Navigation Case Study
blocks.zh: IV-D 语义学对象-目标导航案例研究

blocks.en: IV-D 1 Task and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: IV-D 1 任务和评价议定书

blocks.en:
We further evaluate the practical utility of our 3D pipeline on semantic object-goal navigation, where a robot is required to approach a specified object [ 32 ] .
Experiments are conducted in a real-world privacy-constrained indoor environment shown in Fig. 1 , using the 3D semantic map constructed from HR depth and ULR RGB without access to HR RGB observations.
We consider four target objects: chair , sofa , table , and door .
blocks.zh:
我们进一步评价我们3D管道在语义对象-目标导航方面的实际效用,其中机器人需要接近特定对象[32].
实验是在图1所示现实世界的受隐私限制的室内环境中进行的,使用从HR深度和ULR RGB构造的3D语义图,无法访问HR RGB观测.
我们考虑四个目标物体:椅子、沙发、桌子和门。

blocks.en:
For each semantic query, the predicted 3D regions of the target class are projected onto the navigation map to generate candidate goal poses.
A navigation attempt is considered valid if its resulting stopping pose lies within the valid goal region of a corresponding ground-truth object.
We report Grounding Precision , defined as the number of valid goal candidates divided by the total number of generated candidates, and Grounding Recall , defined as the number of ground-truth objects covered by at least one valid candidate divided by the total number of ground-truth objects.
blocks.zh:
对于每个语义查询,目标类中预测的3D区域被投射到导航地图上,以生成候选目标阵容.
如果导航尝试在相应的地面真人物体的有效目标区域内造成其停止状态,则被视为有效。
我们报告 " 地面精确度 " ,定义为有效目标候选人人数除以产生的候选人总数, " 地面召回 " ,定义为至少一个有效候选人所覆盖的地面真物数目除以地面真物总数。

blocks.en: IV-D 2 Results
blocks.zh: 四-D 2 结果

blocks.en:
As shown in Table V , our pipeline achieves a Grounding Precision of 71.4 % 71.4\% and a Grounding Recall of 83.3 % 83.3\% .
Among the six ground-truth objects, five are successfully grounded; the only missed instance is one of the two chairs.
Both table instances are successfully identified, while additional noisy fragments produce two fake goal candidates and account for the lower precision.
The sofa and door are both grounded without additional candidates.
These results demonstrate that the 3D semantic representation obtained from the asymmetric HR depth–ULR RGB input can provide reliable and actionable semantic goals for real-world robot navigation under privacy constraints.
For additional details and experiments, please refer to the accompanying video.
blocks.zh:
如表五所示,我们的管道实现了71.4%的测地精度,83.3%的测地精度。
在六个地面真相物体中,有五个成功地被禁足;唯一遗漏的例子就是两个主席之一。
成功地确定了这两个表格的情况,而额外的噪音片段则产生两个假的入球候选人,并造成精确度较低。
沙发和门都没有其他候选人。
这些结果显示,从不对称的HR深度-ULR RGB输入中获得的3D语义表示可以为在隐私限制下的现实世界机器人导航提供可靠且可操作的语义目标.
欲了解更多详情和实验,请参见所附视频。

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en:
This work introduced a privacy-preserving asymmetric sensing framework that combines HR depth with ULR RGB for 2D-to-3D semantic segmentation.
The results suggest several design considerations for privacy-constrained perception.
The strong asymmetry between HR depth and ULR RGB should be explicitly accounted for, with geometry providing the primary structural information and ULR appearance serving as a complementary cue.
Our privacy analysis further suggests that task-relevant semantic recovery can be partially decoupled from the recovery of sensitive visual details, supporting reconstruction as a task-oriented intermediate representation.
Future work will validate this setting with dedicated ULR imaging hardware under real sensor characteristics.
blocks.zh:
这项工作引入了一个保护隐私的不对称感知框架,将HR深度与ULR RGB结合,用于2D到3D语义分区.
研究结果表明,对隐私受限的观念有若干设计考虑。
人力资源深度与ULR RGB之间的强烈不对称应明确加以说明,几何提供主要的结构信息,ULR外观作为辅助提示。
我们的隐私分析进一步表明,与任务相关的语义恢复可以部分地与敏感视觉细节的恢复脱钩,支持重建作为面向任务的中间代表.
今后的工作将在真正的传感器特性下用专门的ULR成像硬件验证这一设置。
